## Models

- [Get a Model](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/models/retrieve.md): Get a specific model.
- [List Models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/models/list.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
